jobs.prompt:
Monitor Equinet n8n ticket /opt/data/profiles/equinet-a1-icp-discovery/runtime/n8n-poll-tickets/A1-20260911124516-B16386.json. This is a fresh cron session.
Use python3 with the full profile-relative skill paths below; do not invoke absolute interpreter binaries. Never call cronjob from this cron run and never rerun or modify n8n.

Run `python3 skills/system-operations/equinet-n8n-discovery-control/scripts/poll_ticket.py expire --file /opt/data/profiles/equinet-a1-icp-discovery/runtime/n8n-poll-tickets/A1-20260911124516-B16386.json` and then `next-action`.

For poll_metadata, call the runtime-discovered n8n execution-detail tool with includeData=false. Persist status with poll_ticket.py observe. Return [SILENT] when non-terminal and unchanged.

For retrieve_result, claim first. Retrieve exactly `Build Final Discovery Result` with includeData=true, nodeNames restricted to that node and truncateData=1. Persist the compact envelope, SHA-256 and mark-retrieved. Never fetch all-node execution data.

For recover_claim, do not retrieve again automatically; report operator recovery required.

For process_result:
1. Validate `contract_version: a1.discovery-result.v1`.
2. Use a deterministic sibling work directory named `two-lane-v1`. Run `python3 skills/post-n8n-public-website-enrichment/scripts/route_and_overlay.py next-action --input <discovery-result.json> --work-dir <two-lane-v1>` before acting. Never infer the next phase from conversation history.
3. For `route_result`, run the router into `<two-lane-v1>`. It writes immutable lane subsets, a routing index, and no-website overlays keyed by exact fingerprint.
4. For `stage_no_website`, run `stage_twenty_rest.py` with the no-website subset and no-website overlays into `<two-lane-v1>/staging-no-website`. Skip this action when that lane count is zero. Never reuse a non-empty incomplete staging directory.
5. For `init_enrichment`, initialise `a1.website-enrichment-state.v2` from the website-candidate subset.
6. For `research_enrichment_batch`, request only the research phase (`next --phase research`), claim each lead with the cron job ID, lease ID and expected revision, verify the official site with approved web tools, retain destination citations, and submit one `a1.website-enrichment-research-results.v2` record per claim. A verified result moves to `assessment_pending`; it is not terminal. Item-level source/access failures use structured failure codes and bounded retries.
7. For `assessment_enrichment_batch`, request only the assessment phase, claim each lead, and submit evidence-linked classification, qualification and confidence objects separately. Unknown facts remain explicit `unknown` values. Evidence-backed `out_of_scope` may terminate without fabricated downstream objects. Omitted assessment objects are incomplete work, not fallback.
8. For `run_ready_scoring`, execute `.venv/bin/python skills/post-n8n-public-website-enrichment/scripts/manage_enrichment.py run-ready` for one ready lead with the cron job ID as owner. Each successful score is checkpointed independently. Retriable wrapper failures are bounded; deterministic schema/configuration failures stop for operator repair instead of looping.
9. For `build_website_overlays`, generate and validate overlays only after the v2 state summary reports `build_overlays`. Allowed outcomes are scored, evidence-backed out-of-scope, researched none-found, terminal verification failure, or explicit exhausted assessment failure. A missing n8n website candidate remains `website_candidate_not_provided`. Any unexplained verified-unscored item blocks staging.
10. For `stage_website`, run `stage_twenty_rest.py` with the website subset and website overlays into `<two-lane-v1>/staging-website`. The worker must reject unexplained verified-unscored overlays before any write.
11. For `merge_indexes`, merge lane indexes into `<two-lane-v1>/final-staging-index.json` using `a1.twenty-entity-staging-index.v3`, requiring exact source hash, lane membership, Company/Person expectation coverage, verified IDs, relation reconciliation and clean website-overlay provenance. Empty lanes require no lane index.
12. Only after the final index is complete, run poll_ticket.py mark-consumed with that final index path. `mark-consumed` rechecks the retrieved result hash, run ID, fingerprint order, lane membership, aggregate counts, website-overlay provenance, Company IDs, expected Person IDs, `companyId` relation status and both reconciliation artifacts.
13. Any `operator_repair_*` action must stop and report the exact persisted blocker. Never repeat an uncertain write, re-fetch n8n data, or recursively manage cron.

For deliver_terminal, summarize routed no-website and website-candidate counts, enriched/scored/fallback counts, staged/possible-match/sync-failed/missing-name counts, and the final-index reference. State the HubSpot screen limitation and human-review boundary. Mark delivered immediately before returning the summary.

For stop, return [SILENT].
